'''Insurgent''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He served as an agent for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] group [[Black Epsilon]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].
